'''Hulgren''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like creatures that could grow up to 40 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length. They were gray in [[Color/Legends|coloration]] and had numerous [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. They were found in the lower levels of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], [[Hosk Station/Legends|Hosk Station]].
